description: Compact and efficient. Well-lit throughout. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: An L-shaped sofa in the living zone faces toward the centre of the room; a smaller sofa sits adjacent in the central space facing the living area.. Dining table (4 seats). Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, L-shaped corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room. Storage: one wardrobe. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child. Not suitable for: households needing a home office or dedicated workspace (no desk or extra room); large families (only 2 bedrooms with one being small); those wanting a bathtub (shower only).
